claims.statement: Tom Allen was one of the well-known fighters who boxed at Mozart Hall, Broadway and Biddle street, St. Louis, in the period from about 1868 to 1874.
claims.excerpt: Jem Mace, Tom Allen, Aaron Jones, Mike MeCoole, Dublin (Hastings) Tricks and Charley Gallaher.
places: Mozart Hall, Broadway and Biddle street, St. Louis

notes: Bouts at Mozart Hall are called sparring matches in the text, but were real contests; no individual bout is described. Hint kept as exhibition.
